title: Local Business Leads input
description: Pick a type of business and a place. Each business found in Overture Maps open data becomes one row with its name, address, phone, website, email and social profiles. Turn on website contacts to also read each business's own site for an email, more phones, WhatsApp and social profiles.

searchCategory.title: Type of business
searchCategory.description: What to look for. Leave both this and the place empty to run the example (dentists in Austin, TX).

searchLocation.title: Place
searchLocation.description: A city, town or neighbourhood anywhere in the world, e.g. "Austin, TX", "Manchester, UK" or "Westlands, Nairobi". Adding the country helps.

maxResults.title: Max businesses
maxResults.description: Stop after saving this many businesses. The best-attested businesses come first. Each saved business is charged once.

enrichFromWebsite.title: Add contacts from each business website
enrichFromWebsite.description: Read each business's own website (homepage and contact page, only where robots.txt allows) for a business email, phone numbers, WhatsApp and social profiles. Slower, and included in the price.

requireContact.title: Only businesses with a phone or email
requireContact.description: Skip businesses with no phone, email or WhatsApp, from the listing or (when on) their website. Skipped businesses are not charged.

onlyWithWebsite.title: Only businesses that list a website
onlyWithWebsite.description: Skip businesses whose listing has no website.

includeChains.title: Include chains
includeChains.description: Keep branch locations of chains and franchises (places linked to a brand). Off by default, since their contacts are usually head office.
